sentences.en: British Mycological Society The BMS was founded in 1896 with the sole objective of promoting mycology in all its aspects.

sentences.en: Consider sending samples for mycological examination in people without previous positive mycology - the absence of fungi suggests another diagnosis.

sentences.en: Roy Watling, retired Head of Mycology at the Royal Botanical Gardens, Edinburgh, describes some of the intricacies of fungal systematics.

sentences.en: In addition the journal also covers virology, mycology, and parasitology.

sentences.en: Text books of mycology typically end the chapter on Laboulbeniales with a statement on their economic and commercial insignificance.

sentences.en: Medical Mycology lends itself to illustration and as such there are over 40 additional images in this edition.

sentences.en: This medium is used frequently in medical mycology because the antibiotics usually do not inhibit the growth of human fungal pathogens.
